A status check reporting "disconnected" just means no action has been sent yet, not that something is broken or that you lack a way to connect. Never ask the user to connect for you or claim you have no way to establish a connection: simply act (e.g. call look) and the session will open on its own.

Use the `page` tool: call it with no input to see the next page, or with "q" to stop paging and get back to normal play.
